system.description:
Dancers are practitioners of the alluring art of dance. They have a flair for enlivening their audience and giving awe-inspiring shows.


Iconic Dancers

• Apsalar, Malazan Book of the Fallen

• Azura, Fire Emblem Fates

• Sandrilene fa Toren, The Circle Opens


Playing Dancer

The dancer is a low-defense support with a focus on action efficiency. Grant Actions through Step Up, as your main offenses will occur when you Crit on Reflex Saves.


Action: Step Up

Move: Midline


Training: Finesse, Performance

features.name: Step Up
features.description: Once per Round when you Move, you can make a Finesse Check. On a pass, one Being of your choice other than yourself that sees you can immediately take an extra Action.

features.name: Footloose
features.description: You gain the Fallaway Reverse Perk and, when you make a Reflex Save, roll two d20s and use the higher result.

features.name: Evasive
features.description: Once per Round after another Being uses an Action or Move, you can Move 10’ without using Speed and can continue moving using your remaining Speed. This free Speed increases by 5’ every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Captivator
features.description:
When you pass a Finesse Check or Crit on any Save, you can cause a Being that can see you to become Berserk, Charmed, Confused, or Frightened for Cd4 Rounds. Once this ends, they are immune to this Ability for the Shift.


This countdown die increases to a Cd6 at 8th Level.

features.name: Don't Stop Me Now
features.description: Difficult Terrain doesn’t impede your walking Speed, and you have Favor on Saves against being Paralyzed, Restrained, grappled, or moved.

features.name: Captivator
features.description: When you pass a Finesse Check or Crit on any Save, you can cause a Being that can see you to become Berserk, Charmed, Confused, or Frightened for Cd6 Rounds. Once this ends, they are immune to this Ability for the Shift.

features.name: Double Time
features.description: You can use Step Up twice per Round, rather than once, and the Beings you use it on can also Move up to 10’ without using their Speed that Turn.
